description: This PHP file defines the 'Online' controller class within the Opencart e-commerce system's admin report module. The class handles displaying and retrieving the list of online customers, including filtering by customer name or IP address, pagination, and generating view output for the online customers report page.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for the online customers report in the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the online report page, including setting up breadcrumbs, language, header, footer, and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX or direct request to display the list of online customers by invoking getList and outputting the result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered, paginated list of online customers, fetches customer info, and prepares data for the report view.
